method: Excel 16.0 COM CalculateFullRebuild on temporary copies; calculateJVOrder receives raw dimensions, selectors, quantities, source-backed family snapshots, and provenance-matched Main settings. Exact rational-to-Value2 comparisons use no epsilon; display comparisons use captured Excel NumberFormat and Text.
scope: 12 independent LINE-only scenarios (6 per profile): one position, quantity extension, and orders with 2 and 3 Line positions. These test calculateLineOrder plus the captured Main R/Y/AA transfer through Главная!AA18. They do not establish mixed-family engine parity.
